title: Efficient PH3 removal over Cu-doped active carbon with stable active Cu2+ species enabled by nitrogen modification
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EN00732A, Paper
Yihui He, Lin Ye, Wanglai Cen, Jianjun Li, Dengrong Sun
A new method of nitrogen doping in Cu-active carbon is reported to realize highly efficient PH3 removal performance, due to the stabilized active Cu2+ by the doped nitrogen.
